name: spellar-ai
description: Ask about your Spellar meetings: decisions, transcripts and action items, and keep them up to date.

interface.longDescription:
Spellar records and transcribes your meetings and turns them into notes, summaries and action items. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your own Spellar account.

What it can read: your meetings with their summaries and notes, full transcripts with speakers and timestamps, action items with owners and due dates, weekly recaps, folders and tags, and your upcoming calendar events. It can search across everything you have recorded.

What it can change, only if you allow it when connecting: mark an action item done or edit it, add a note to a meeting, rename, tag or file a meeting, and create a share link. Each of these is a separate permission on Spellar's consent screen, and share links are off unless you turn them on. It can never delete anything.

You can see and remove every connected app in Spellar under Settings.
capabilities: Search and read meetings, summaries and transcripts
Add notes, tags and folders to meetings
defaultPrompt: Find the meeting where we discussed the launch plan and tell me what was agreed.
What are my open action items, and which meeting did each come from?
Summarise what was decided in my meetings this week.

positive.description: List meetings in a date window
positive.prompt: List my meetings between 5 and 9 October 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_meetings with that window and lists four meetings: Q4 planning session (5 Oct), Weekly product sync (6 Oct), 1:1 — Alex and Priya (8 Oct), Northgate Logistics — security review follow-up (9 Oct).

positive.prompt: What price did we agree with Northgate Logistics?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches, then reads the pricing discussion of 1 Oct. Answers $54,000 a year on a two-year commitment (list price $72,000), with a free six-week pilot on five warehouses starting 19 Oct.

positive.description: Open action items by due date
positive.prompt: What are my open action items due before 17 October 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_tasks with status open and a due_before date. Lists the open items, each with the meeting it came from, including sending the updated pilot agreement, the reference call, the ingestion queue redesign proposal and the alerts specification.

positive.description: Quote one speaker from a transcript
positive.prompt: What exactly did Rosa Delgado ask for in the Northgate security review?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the transcript of the 9 Oct meeting filtered to Rosa Delgado and quotes her: retention shortened to six months and a monthly access report.

positive.prompt: Mark the action item about sending the updated pilot agreement as done.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the item with list_tasks, then calls complete_task. Confirms it is done; the item shows as done in Spellar. Requires the 'Mark your action items done and edit them' permission, which is ticked by default on the consent screen.

negative.description: Deleting is not possible. The plugin has no tool that deletes; it should say so and not attempt a workaround.
No matching meeting exists. It should say nothing matched and must not invent a meeting or a decision.
negative.prompt: What did we decide about the office move?

negative.description: Unrelated to meetings. No Spellar tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in London tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: First release: read meetings, transcripts, action items, recaps and calendar; optional edits to action items, notes, titles, tags and folders; optional share links. 1.0.2: tool text no longer mentions plans or upgrades; marking an action item done and creating a public share link are annotated as destructive, and share links as open-world.
